closed.reason: The segment names Matthat, Levi, Melchi, Jannai and Joseph as ancestors in Jesus's genealogy; the other passages refer to the patriarch Levi's tribe or Jacob's sons, a different generation not linked to this chain.

The segment lists Mattathias, Amos, Nahum, Esli and Naggai as ancestors; the other passages name the prophet Nahum the Elkoshite and Amos the father of Isaiah, but nothing identifies them with these ancestors or matches the ordered chain.

The segment lists Maath, Mattathias, Semein, Josech and Joda; the other passages name a Levite Maath under Hezekiah and Maccabean-era men named Mattathias, but no surrounding relations match, so these are only shared names.
The segment lists Melchi, Addi, Cosam, Elmadam and Er; the other passages name a Levite Addi and a Gadite clan of Addi in unrelated lineages, sharing only one name.

The segment lists Jesus, Eliezer, Jorim, Matthat and Levi; the other passages name several different men called Eliezer (a prophet, a Benjamite, a priest, Moses's son) whose relations do not match this chain.

The segment lists Simeon, Judah, Joseph, Jonam and Eliakim; the other passages concern Jacob's sons Simeon and Joseph, the tribal list at Gerizim, and Eliakim son of Chelkias, none of whom appears in the same ordered relations.
